info.title: Hospital Management System API
info.description: REST API for the ALGIONS AI LABS Hospital Management System assessment. All endpoints except login/health require the `hms_session` cookie returned by `POST /api/auth/login`. Responses use `{ data }` on success and `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` on failure. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; the hospital operates in IST (UTC+05:30). Money is integer paise.

details.description: Field errors for VALIDATION_ERROR: { fieldErrors, formErrors }

version.description: Send back on reschedule/cancel/status for optimistic locking

put.summary: Replace weekly schedule (admin). Overlapping windows rejected.

get.summary: Slots for one IST day with availability

post.description: Validates the slot against the doctor's schedule, then inserts. A PostgreSQL exclusion constraint guarantees no overlapping active appointments for the same doctor or patient, even under concurrent requests.
